name: Mirax Circus Queen

features.name: Two respin buys
features.description: 85x for three regular respins, or an enhanced option.

review:
Mirax Circus Queen is a 40-line circus slot with magician's hats, binoculars and masks. Wilds and stacked wilds help complete wins, and bonus symbols activate a respins round.

Chance x2 increases the bet to make bonus symbols more likely. The respin round can also be bought where permitted, with two options: 85x the bet for three regular respins, or a more expensive enhanced option. BGaming rates it medium-high volatility with a 1,172x maximum and a 96% RTP. It shares its structure with Joker Queen.
pros: Published game data available from the provider
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
